title: The Banished [Spirit Medium] Houses the Power of Heroic Spirits and Becomes the Strongest
description:
The weakest class, thought only capable of purifying souls, is actually the ultimate hack that grants the power of Heroic Spirits!?

Luke is a [Spirit Medium] serving in the Hero's party.

While he dedicated himself to conversing with ghosts and cleansing their souls, his comrades dismissed his efforts as "wasting time on monsters" and cruelly banished him from the group. As he wanders through a dungeon in the depths of despair, he discovers a young girl being hunted by a lethal Undead Knight. Guided by his grandmother's teaching—that a true spirit medium protects both the living and the dead—Luke leaps into action regardless of the risk. In that moment of peril, a "Heroic Spirit" slumbering within the dungeon resonates with his heart—and Luke becomes a vessel for the power of the azure flames!

From the Sword God who halted a massive monster invasion to the Pirate Queen who defended her castle against a tyrannical empire—wielding the extraordinary abilities of legendary Heroic Spirits, his journey to become the strongest spirit medium begins!
author: Domadoma
